items.title: Expose explicit component mapping metadata in both fact registries
items.context: Implement approved-plan P0m fields and normalized paths without changing the existing whole-registry digest preimages.
items.userSees: Registry inspection exposes deterministic fact IDs, normalized paths, component IDs, serialization boundaries, and generated-from lineage needed by later RED/GREEN classification.

happy.desc: Component-filtered process and runtime registry projections are deterministic and include the approved mapping fields.

edge.desc: Existing whole-registry projection preimages remain byte-compatible and exclude generatedFrom.

adversarial.desc: No mapping is inferred from producer, source references, consumer references, or artifact paths.

items.title: Fail closed on incomplete or ambiguous component mappings
items.context: Both contract verifiers must reject missing, ambiguous, non-total, and generated-path-without-generatedFrom cases with the approved typed diagnostic.
items.userSees: Invalid registry mappings stop downstream RED/GREEN classification instead of silently selecting a component.

happy.desc: The complete current registry resolves every required component mapping with zero unavailable results.

edge.desc: A required mapping with missing or non-total metadata is rejected.

adversarial.desc: Ambiguous mappings and generated paths lacking generatedFrom lineage are rejected without fallback inference.

items.title: Bind the P0m contract into regression and process-fact verification
items.context: Add a focused pre-fix RED reproducer, same-command GREEN coverage, mutation checks, and registry verification so later edits cannot remove or weaken P0m unnoticed.
items.userSees: The P0m prerequisite is protected by executable RED/GREEN, adversarial mutation, and process/runtime contract checks.

happy.desc: The committed reproducer fails on the baseline and passes after the component-mapping implementation.

edge.desc: Mutation of each required mapping field causes the focused verification to fail.

adversarial.desc: Concurrent registry projection reads remain deterministic while verification runs.
